reviews.title: want more flexibility with app groups
reviews.text:
doesnt let you restrict both the total amount of use per day AND which hours of the day you can use an app. 
for example: i dont want to use any apps before 10am, but i also dont want to use app xyz for more than 30 min per day. so i restrict app group 1 (containing xyz) to 30 min and restrict app group 2 (the rest of my apps) to before 10. however, i cant include xyz in group 2 since its already in group 1, which is a little frustrating.
also would be nice to be able to edit the apps in an app group after creation.

reviews.title: App is simple, fun, and embarrassing all in one! Fantastic.
reviews.text: I’ve never seen a piece of phone software that can have my own friends control my screen time. It feels so fitting. It’s not a guardian advisor in your life, but people in your own social circles - in which you are afraid of being judged. The app keeps itself very simple: You run out of time, and then you go beg the friends you’ve added! As much as I think this app has the perfect approach (and solid pricing!), I still have to knock down a star because of the lack of some features, such as QoL details like metrics to track how many friends you’ve begged and for how much time, setting time request limits, and not updating screen time requests when you ask for time again from the same friend (it creates a second ask, and if they approve the original, you get extra time.) Otherwise, it’s a great app, and I will continue to get more people on it. Cheers!
